status_public: experimental / research and education only / not clinically validated

cases.opening: Simulated adult, 34 years old. Four days of dry cough, sore throat, myalgias, and fever to 38.1 C after crowded indoor travel. No resting dyspnea, no chest pain, no known chronic lung disease. This is a simulated educational case, not a real person.

differential.label: Viral upper respiratory infection
differential.support: Short course, travel exposure, dry cough.

differential.label: Influenza-like illness
differential.against: No test result in the vignette.

differential.label: Bacterial sinusitis
differential.support: Less likely at day 4 without focal sinus signs.
differential.against: No facial pain or prolonged course.

cases.explain_es: Caso simulado educativo. No es una persona real ni un consejo médico.
cases.explain_en: Simulated educational case. Not a real person and not medical advice.

cases.opening: Simulated adult twisted an ankle during a recreational game. Immediate swelling, can take four steps with pain, no numbness, no open wound. Simulated educational case only.

differential.label: Lateral ankle sprain
differential.against: Fracture not excluded by this vignette.

differential.label: Malleolar fracture
differential.support: Inability to fully weight-bear raises concern.

differential.label: Soft-tissue contusion only
differential.against: Immediate swelling is more than a bruise.

cases.explain_es: Explorador público: solo casos simulados, sin tratamiento.
cases.explain_en: Public explorer: simulated cases only, no treatment advice.

cases.opening: Simulated adult with recurrent one-sided throbbing headache, light sensitivity, and nausea, lasting hours, similar to prior episodes. No fever, no neck stiffness, no new neurological deficit in the vignette. Simulated educational case only.

differential.label: Migraine-like primary headache
differential.against: No clinician exam in this vignette.

differential.label: Tension-type headache
differential.against: Nausea and photophobia are less typical.

differential.label: Secondary headache not characterized here
differential.support: Always a residual category in education.

cases.explain_es: Los porcentajes son didácticos, no una predicción clínica.
cases.explain_en: Percentages are educational, not a clinical prediction.
